summary.text:
DOGWITHIN AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2021-03-22. DOGWITHIN AS drives med utdanning, veiledning, kurs, seminarer, workshops og faglig rådgivning innen hund, atferd, etologi og relasjon mellom menneske og hund. Selskapet tilbyr også individuelle konsultasjoner og kan i begrenset omfang tilby støttetjenester som hundebarnehage, hundepass, lufting, boarding, overnatting og omsorgstjenester. It was previously named PETTERWORLD AS until 2026-03-02. Its main industry code is 85.597: other education activities. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 116 439 NOK and the annual result was -351 NOK; operating income was up from 97 122 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 24 946 NOK in 2024 to -351 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 5 396 NOK in 2024 to -12 505 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is dogwithin.com. The latest news on its own website is "Kan hundebarnehage være etisk?

En realistisk refleksjon rundt stress, ansvar og grenser" from 2026-01-19. Recent changes in the register: industry code set to 85.597 on 2026-03-03; business address set to Bergensgata 12B on 2026-03-02.
